title: Telekom Malaysia bets on agentic AI to meet surging infrastructure demand
summary: Telekom Malaysia, the country’s incumbent operator and its largest fixed-line broadband provider, may be using AI to improve efficiency across its network operations but says AI-led revenue opportunities have yet to emerge.

title: Amdocs nabs 10-year deal for aOS with VEON
summary: As part of the deal, Amdocs can utilize some of VEON’s QazCodes IP rights which will be integrated into its agentic OS launched earlier this year.

title: Vodafone selects CUJO AI to detect quality of outcome in its broadband networks
summary: Rather than assessing a network primarily through technical measures, QoO evaluates how well network conditions support the outcomes users expect from specific applications.

title: Ooredoo's OFN bets on fiber in Iraq to carry Gulf traffic into Europe
summary: Ooredoo's OFN is eyeing Iraq as a new fiber shortcut between the Gulf and Europe as AI and cloud traffic drive demand for more route diversity.

title: Keysight gives RF engineers agentic AI keys to automate design and speed up dev time
summary: Radio frequency (RF) engineering has been slow to adopt agentic AI because it relies on specialist expertise and schematics and layouts that LLMs cannot read in a consistent, deterministic way, said Keysight.

title: UK's Openreach taps Ciena's WaveLogic 6 to deliver 800G
summary: Openreach is using Ciena’s newest optical tech to bring national 800G services to UK wholesale customers chasing more capacity for AI, cloud, data centers and subsea traffic.

title: T-Mobile CTO welcomes competition from SpaceX
summary: “If this is truly the beginning of a new wireless provider in America, we welcome competition," said T-Mobile CTO John Saw in a LinkedIn post about SpaceX. "It's good for innovation, good for the industry, and most importantly, good for customers."

title: New York's transit authority taps Ribbon to move legacy phones to SIP
summary: The MTA is moving its legacy phones to SIP with Ribbon, a deliberately slow ride that keeps old analog lines working while new systems come online.

title: 11:11 Systems bags ‘hundreds’ of VMware customers from IBM
summary: As IBM steps back from VMware, 11:11 Systems is leaning in — snapping up “hundreds” of customers and betting Broadcom’s changes will keep fueling consolidation.

title: SpaceX’s 800 MHz spectrum grab threatens Big 3 mobile carriers even more
summary: SpaceX just inked a deal to buy 14 megahertz of paired 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management, giving Starlink Mobile a means to more aggressively challenge the Big 3 U.S. mobile carriers on the ground.

title: The Five Nine: Are enterprise networks ready for AI?
summary: We break down why AI readiness depends on more than compute power, and why networking, private connectivity, latency, security, automation and network as a service are becoming critical to enterprise AI success.

title: Comments about ‘irrational’ broadband prices were 'cherry on top' of bad year for cable
summary: According to the analysts at TD Cowen, cable broadband subscriber losses could hit record levels during Q3.

title: Verizon’s Adam Koeppe to depart after 26+ years at the company
summary: Adam Koeppe, Verizon SVP and Chief Network Officer/Core, is leaving at the end of this year after spending more than 26 years at the company.

title: Broadband providers face messy road to autonomous networks
summary: Broadband providers are bullish on autonomous networks, but a new report from Broadband Forum says inconsistent data, vendor interoperability and legacy integration could slow the march toward AI-driven operations.

title: Beyond Now launches platform to unlock CSP AI revenue
summary: Beyond Now is taking aim at telcos’ AI monetization gap with a new agentic platform built to turn customer intent, partner ecosystems and AI services into revenue.

title: IonQ lands up to $300M DARPA quantum validation deal
summary: IonQ advanced to Stage C of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, putting its Superion systems through independent validation as it pushes toward utility-scale quantum computing.

title: Arelion, Nokia trial boosts optical capacity for AI traffic
summary: Arelion says a live Amsterdam-to-London field trial with Nokia expanded usable optical spectrum by 21%, adding capacity for AI-driven data center and cloud connectivity.

title: 24% of telcos use spreadsheets and paper to track physical network assets: IQGeo
summary: An IQGeo survey found that 50% of operators keep records across multiple systems. Only 25% said they use a single, integrated geospatial system.

title: Nokia campus sale nears as Hotard bets on industrial AI
summary: Nokia may soon name a buyer for its campus private networks unit as rivals gain share, but CEO Justin Hotard is betting on bigger money in industrial infrastructure.

title: SpaceX scores 15K-satellite win as FCC doubles down on D2D
summary: SpaceX is getting a lot more support from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) for Elon Musk's quest to more aggressively challenge the Big 3 mobile carriers in the U.S.

title: AI agents turn old dependencies into new attack surfaces
summary: AI is shrinking the window between software flaws being discovered and exploited — and Red Hat says that should worry telcos sitting on years-old open-source code.

title: Indoor cellular experts ponder SpaceX’s entry into wireless
summary: SpaceX may shake up wireless with a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network, but indoor connectivity remains a challenge.

title: Opinion: Can carriers finally move up the stack? AT&T, Cisco and NVIDIA say AI changes the equation
summary: Connectivity gets operators into the game, but compute, security and control could move them up the stack.

title: Telstra lights Perth-Sydney fiber route to bolster Australia’s digital backbone
summary: Telstra’s Aura Network just got a major east-west boost, giving AI, cloud and data center players another high-capacity path across Australia.

title: Arista gets into scale-up game as accelerator landscape diversifies
summary: As AI clusters get denser and accelerators diversify beyond Nvidia, Arista is making a move inside the rack with liquid-cooled, Ethernet-based scale-up networking and betting that open standards can crack a domain long ruled by proprietary interconnects.
